description: This source file is a shell script used for testing notes merging functionality in a Git repository. It sets up various scenarios involving notes refs, merges, conflicts, and verification of notes states, fanout structures, and merge behaviors.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes for a specific reference and commit, comparing with expected output files.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree for a given reference has a fanout of 1, by validating paths.

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Checks if the notes tree for a given reference has a fanout of 0, by validating paths.
